VesselPreset.name: Abyssal Monolith
VesselPreset.author: VESSEL II
VesselPreset.description: Tectonic legato monolith sub locking mono low-end weight below 120 Hz under a dark harmonic ladder growl. Macro 1 piles on sub-octave mass; Macro 2 fractures the upper register through starved-adjacent triode heat.

VesselPreset.name: Tectonic Reese
VesselPreset.author: VESSEL II
VesselPreset.description: Seismic moving Reese bass driven by dual 64-bit ZDF ladders, Pentode warmth, and multiband glue while sub-120 Hz remains mono-anchored. Sweep SNARL to tear open the midrange or THROB to accelerate its beating pulse.

VesselPreset.name: Subterranean Acid
VesselPreset.author: VESSEL II
VesselPreset.description: Venomous resonant acid-industrial bass with 64-bit ZDF squelch, through-zero FM edge, and starved asymmetric tube saturation over a tight mono sub foundation.

VesselPreset.name: Ferrofluid 808
VesselPreset.author: VESSEL II
VesselPreset.description: Club-ready ferrofluid 808 with transient FM strike knock, tape-bias sag, Pentode upper harmonics that translate on small speakers, and surgical mono sub-bass discipline.

VesselPreset.name: Valkyrie Brass
VesselPreset.author: VESSEL II
VesselPreset.description: Brooding, emotionally charged MPE analog brass with slow ladder bloom, organic tape patina, and procedural tape air. Dig into Aftertouch or Slide CC74 for monumental brass flare.

VesselPreset.name: Oxide Siren
VesselPreset.author: VESSEL II
VesselPreset.description: Haunting legato dystopian vocal-saw lead with resonant formant throat, through-zero FM shimmer, and deep VHS pitch instability. Built for expressive solo phrasing with Mod Wheel and Aftertouch.

VesselPreset.name: Ashen Horn
VesselPreset.author: VESSEL II
VesselPreset.description: Sorrowful dystopian French horn cast inside concrete chamber acoustics with voice-gated tape air, triode warmth, and deep MPE breath phrasing.

VesselPreset.name: Neon Fracture
VesselPreset.author: VESSEL II
VesselPreset.description: Razor-edged industrial through-zero FM lead running parallel dual ZDF ladders, starved tube grit, and metallic transient strike for cutting through dense IDM and techno arrangements.

VesselPreset.name: Obsidian Cathedral
VesselPreset.author: VESSEL II
VesselPreset.description: Vast gothic dark-choir pad fusing slowly morphed vocal harmonics, a wide harmonic drone bed, and 16-second Black Hole reverberation with mono-locked bass clarity.

VesselPreset.name: Glacial Void
VesselPreset.author: VESSEL II
VesselPreset.description: Hypnotic crystalline sci-fi atmosphere combining octave-up granular shimmer, metallic FM halo, voice-gated tape air, and deep Black Hole tail.

VesselPreset.name: Rust Requiem
VesselPreset.author: VESSEL II
VesselPreset.description: Decaying analog chamber strings saturated through tape bias sag, stairwell convolution, and rich organic pitch drift. Instant melancholic film-score texture from a single chord.

VesselPreset.name: Solar Eclipse
VesselPreset.author: VESSEL II
VesselPreset.description: Monumental widescreen harmonic-drift pad sculpted by a breathing formant cavity, multiband cohesion, and sub-anchored phase spectra. Macro 1 shifts the eclipse formant and harmonic brightness.

VesselPreset.name: Cryo Bell
VesselPreset.author: VESSEL II
VesselPreset.description: Crystalline-to-rusted physical bell uniting modal Bell resonance, high-ratio through-zero FM shimmer, and 6-mode metallic transient strike. Velocity dynamically unlocks glassy upper partials.

VesselPreset.name: Clockwork Mallet
VesselPreset.author: VESSEL II
VesselPreset.description: Tactile fractured IDM percussion mallet combining Glass Marimba, physical Bar resonance, metallic transient exciter, and granular glitch routing.

VesselPreset.name: Glass Tines
VesselPreset.author: VESSEL II
VesselPreset.description: Intimate dark electric keys pairing glass formant tones with bell-like FM tine bark, cassette-shell intimacy, organic tape wobble, and expressive MPE dynamics.

VesselPreset.name: Iron Harpsichord
VesselPreset.author: VESSEL II
VesselPreset.description: Plucked industrial metallic harpsichord driven by a physical String waveguide, FM Acetate harmonics, Pentode crunch, and stairwell reflections.

VesselPreset.name: Kinetic Anthem
VesselPreset.author: VESSEL II
VesselPreset.description: Festival-scale dark club chord anthem powered by stacked fifth saws, multiband OTT punch, harmonic exciter sheen, and mono-locked low end. Sweep DROP from tight warehouse stabs to stadium lift.

VesselPreset.name: Strobe Hook
VesselPreset.author: VESSEL II
VesselPreset.description: Peak-time warehouse hook built on folded saws, rhythmic Pump LFO filter modulation, metallic transient attack, and Pentode crunch engineered to slice through heavy kick-and-bass mixes.

VesselPreset.name: Hyperdrive Riser
VesselPreset.author: VESSEL II
VesselPreset.description: High-voltage tension weapon combining synth brass harmonics, Plate resonator overtones, accelerating LFO motion, and tape-air rush. Twist IGNITE for dramatic drop builds.

VesselPreset.name: Monolith Drop
VesselPreset.author: VESSEL II
VesselPreset.description: Hybrid bass-chord drop weapon combining Dark Matter growl harmonics, vocal formant snarl, starved tube fury, OTT slam, and sub-120 Hz mono-anchored octave weight.
